surah.personality_title: 'Abasa — The Divine Rebuke & The Moral Priority of the Seeker
surah.personality_summary: Moral, pastoral, introspective, humbling. Opens with a historic divine rebuke of the Prophet prioritizing powerful pagan elites over the blind, sincere seeker Ibn Umm Maktum, establishing that spiritual reception outweighs social pedigree. Transitions to ingratitude for human genesis and concludes with the Deafening Blast where man flees from his brother, mother, and father.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Abasa (He frowned) is the 80th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 42 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم عبس وتولى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Prophet frowned and turned away
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He frowned and turned away

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the blind man came to him––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for all you know, he might have grown in spirit

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: or taken note of something useful to him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As for he who thinks himself without need
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: For the self-satisfied one

ayahs.translation_saheeh: To him you give attention
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you go out of your way––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: though you are not to be blamed for his lack of spiritual growth––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but from the one who has come to you full of eagerness

ayahs.translation_saheeh: While he fears [Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and awe

ayahs.translation_saheeh: From him you are distracted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you allow yourself to be distracted

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! This [Quran] is a lesson

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So whoever wills may remember it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: from which those who wish to be taught should learn

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [It is recorded] in honored sheets
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [written] on honoured

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Exalted and purified
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: exalted, pure pages

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the hands of

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Noble and dutiful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: noble and virtuous scribes

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe to man! How ungrateful he is

ayahs.translation_saheeh: From what substance did He create him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: From what thing does God create him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He creates him from a droplet, He proportions him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then He eased the way for him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He makes the way easy for him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: then He causes him to die and be buried

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When He wills, He will raise him up again

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yet mandoes not fulfil God’s commands

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then let mankind look at his food
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Let man consider the food he eats

ayahs.translation_saheeh: How We poured down water in torrents
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We pour down abundant water

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and cause the soil to split open

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And caused to grow within it grain
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We make grain grow

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And grapes and herbage
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and vines, fresh vegetation

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And olive and palm trees
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: olive trees, date palms

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And gardens of dense shrubbery
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: luscious gardens

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And fruit and grass
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: fruits, and fodder

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: all for you and your livestock to enjoy

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the Deafening Blast comes––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the Day man will flee from his own brother

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And his mother and his father
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: his mother, his father

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And his wife and his children
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: his wife, his children

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ شَأۡنࣱ يُغۡنِيهِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لكل امرئ منهم يومئذ شان يغنيه
ayahs.translation_saheeh: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: each of them will be absorbed in concerns of their own on that Day

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on that Day some faces will be beaming

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Laughing, rejoicing at good news
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: laughing, and rejoicing

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but some faces will be dust-stained

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Blackness will cover them
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and covered in darkness

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: those are the disbelievers, the licentious
